test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 9 Feb 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: What will be the amount (in Rs.) of annual payment that will discharge a debt of Rs. 1,025 due in 2 years at the rate of 5% compound interest per annum?
solution:
**Given:**

Debt amount = Rs 1025

Time = 2 years

Rate of interest = 5% per annum

**Concept Used:**

Amount = P(1+(r)/(100))^t

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let the annual payment be Rs x.

⇒ Amount for first year + Amount for second year = Rs 1025

⇒ (x)/((1+frac{5){100})}+(x)/((1+frac{5){100})²}=1025

⇒ (x)/(frac{105){100}}+(x)/(frac{105){100}times (105)/(100)}=1025

⇒ (20x)/(21)+(400x)/(441)=1025

⇒ (20x)/(21)+(400x)/(441)=1025

⇒ 420x + 400x = 1025 × 441

⇒ 820x = 452,025

⇒ x = (452025)/(820)=551.25

**Therefore, the amount of each annual payment is Rs 551.25**
